pois.name: Derelict relay satellite
pois.ceresMsg: Salvage logged: two serviceable components and one very patient radio. Filed under 'things worth drifting for.'

pois.name: Frozen cargo pod
pois.ceresMsg: Manifest's intact under the frost. Three parts worth cannibalizing, and one piece of produce I am frankly amazed survived the trip.

pois.name: Old escape pod
pois.ceresMsg: Pod's long empty. Whoever rode it out logged a landing beacon before the recording cuts — filed as a discovery, not a mystery.
